links.outcome: Proportion of cases with at least one potential safety issue, compared across age, complexity, insurance
links.effect: Safety issues differed across age groups (p = 0.031), patient complexity (p < 0.001) and insurance types (p = 0.047); medication correctness and UMS format did not differ by group.
links.quote: There was evidence of a difference in the proportion of cases with at least one potential safety issue across age groups (p = 0.031), patient complexity (p < 0.001) and insurance types (p = 0.047).

links.outcome: Presence of potential safety issues in AI-generated medication instructions rated by clinical experts
links.effect: Potential safety issues in 69.3% (97/140) of cases, despite most medications being included (95% had all medications included).
links.quote: Despite most medications being included, potential safety issues were identified in 69.3 % (97/140).

unlisted_practices: Considering severity and likelihood of safety issues when evaluating AI-generated patient messaging

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the safety, accuracy, and equity of GPT-4o in generating discharge medication instructions using retrospective EHR data (MIMIC), but does not test a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
